activities.description: Politician 2 describes their upcoming schedule of events.
Politician 1 talks about the crowd's enthusiasm and the state of New Hampshire.
Politician 1 is asked about the amount of time he has spent in Iowa and responds to the narrative surrounding it.
Politician 1 is asked if the large number of Republican candidates is concerning and he responds with a positive perspective.

Politician 1 is asked if he thinks his outspoken views on controversial issues could hurt the GOP in 2016. He responds by saying that he answers questions directly and focuses on economic and fiscal issues.
Politician 1 is asked if he believes Trump's rhetoric is hurting the GOP. He responds by saying that Trump can speak for himself and that he will focus on telling people what he's for.
Politician 1 is asked how big of a role public sector unions will play in his presidential messaging. He reiterates that he will focus on reform, growth, and safety.

characterInteraction.description: Politician 1 is the central figure, answering questions and engaging with reporters.
Politician 2 primarily observes and occasionally guides the interview flow.

narrativeProgression.description: Politician 1 expresses pride in the crowd's enthusiasm and emphasizes New Hampshire's independence.
Politician 1 highlights his recent entry into the presidential race.
Politician 1 defends his outspoken nature and emphasizes his focus on economic and fiscal issues.
Politician 1 distances himself from Trump's rhetoric and reiterates his focus on policy.
Politician 1 reaffirms his commitment to reform, growth, and safety.
